lede: Cache 1.1 is in testing on phones. It becomes stable when every must-have below works on each kind of device and Ask is fast enough.

lines.text: Launch check on a Pixel 8, updating from the build before: libraries and linked devices are kept; watched folders, map icons and pin styles, the question that sets how settings sync, and Stop while Ask is searching.
On Google Play testing (internal, closed and open).
Google Play for everyone, until 1.1 is finished.
New Library and Bookshelves, adding PDFs with OCR, search inside your books.
Watched folders (new PDFs you drop in a folder are added on their own), map icons and colors for notebooks and places, and one question that sets how settings sync between two devices.
Notebooks that sync cleanly between devices, full-size photos, and a clearer log for problem reports.
Android Auto, being readied for Google's car review. CarPlay follows.

cards.title: Ask: speed and accuracy
cards.goals: Goals: the first words within 15–20 s on a Pixel 8, then writing faster than you read · at least 85% of answers mostly correct

lines.text: The phone reads the question and its sources far slower than it should.
A changing line in the instructions throws away work Cache had saved between questions.
Some answers skip searching your library when they shouldn't.
Timing older builds on the same phone to find where it slowed down.
Fixed instructions, checked against a set of real questions before they ship.
